subject.title: Feature Request: TUI Notification When Agent Completes (Sound/Desktop Alert)

question: Should OpenClaw core add a default-off TUI completion notification contract now, and which initial modes should it support: terminal bell only, desktop notification, configurable sound, or a smaller subset?
rationale: This request adds user-visible TUI behavior and public config keys across platform-specific notification surfaces, so automation should not choose defaults, OS backends, or config names without maintainer intent.

options.title: Define a minimal default-off TUI notifier
options.body: Approve a narrow TUI-owned contract, likely starting with terminal bell plus optional platform notifier, with config schema/help/docs and PTY proof before implementation.

options.title: Defer to broader activity/watchdog design
options.body: Keep this open but wait until the broader session activity and alerting work settles how OpenClaw should notify users about completed or stuck work.

options.title: Reject core notification surface
options.body: Close or redirect if maintainers want completion alerts to live in companion apps, plugins, or external automation rather than core TUI config.

recommendation.title: Define a minimal default-off TUI notifier
recommendation.body: Approve a narrow TUI-owned contract, likely starting with terminal bell plus optional platform notifier, with config schema/help/docs and PTY proof before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current-history signal across TUI product behavior, status/finalization adjacency, and config-sensitive UI work.
